## File: facebookresearch_efm3d/efm3d/thirdparty/mmdetection3d/iou3d.py

Prompts

```
['build a python module to calculate differentiable IoU of rotated 2D boxes given two tensors of shape (B, N, 5)', 'build a python module to calculate differentiable IoU of rotated 3D boxes given two tensors of shape (B, N, 7)', 'create a RotatedIoU3DLoss module to compute 1 minus IoU loss between predicted and target 3D rotated bounding boxes', 'run boxes_iou_bev to calculate IoU between two sets of boxes in bird-eye view and return an (M, N) tensor', 'run nms_gpu to perform GPU-accelerated rotated non-maximum suppression on boxes with scores and a threshold']
```

Usage

```
{'calculate_diff_iou_rotated_2d': 'build a python module to calculate differentiable IoU of rotated 2D boxes given two tensors of shape (B, N, 5)', 'calculate_diff_iou_rotated_3d': 'build a python module to calculate differentiable IoU of rotated 3D boxes given two tensors of shape (B, N, 7)', 'create_rotated_iou_3d_loss': 'create a RotatedIoU3DLoss module to compute 1 minus IoU loss between predicted and target 3D rotated bounding boxes', 'run_boxes_iou_bev': 'run boxes_iou_bev to calculate IoU between two sets of boxes in bird-eye view and return an (M, N) tensor', 'run_nms_gpu': 'run nms_gpu to perform GPU-accelerated rotated non-maximum suppression on boxes with scores and a threshold'}
```
